finalText:
All 625 pass now.

Only 3 cases were really broken, all in the order totals suite. The rest of the wall of text was noise.

The bug was in `orderTotal` in `src/pricing.js`. It took the discount off, but then figured the tax on the **full** price instead of the discounted one. So customers were taxed on money they never paid.

The fix is one line: tax the discounted amount.

Most rows had either no discount or no tax, so they looked fine either way. Only the three rows with both could show the problem.
